name: HoTPP benchmark
description: A benchmark focused on long-horizon event forecasting performance, assessing methods' ability to predict rare or long-range temporal events.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark for long-horizon and rare-event forecasting; adopted in niche time-series forecasting and temporal-event communities but not yet mainstream.
notes: Focuses on rare/long-range events so class imbalance and volatility are major issues; potential contamination when real-world streams overlap with training sources; results can be dataset-size sensitive and not directly comparable to short-horizon forecasting benchmarks.
